# `Q-5-35` — Book chapter file not found

> A file listed in `book.chapters`, `book.appendices`, or
> `book.references` does not exist on disk.

## What this means

Unlike a website project — which renders every document it finds — a
book project renders exactly the files named by its chapter list.
Every entry in `book.chapters`, `book.appendices`, and
`book.references` must therefore point at a real file in the project
directory. One of them does not.

Paths are resolved relative to the project root (the directory
containing `_quarto.yml`).

## Why this happens

- **A typo in the chapter path** — `chaptres/intro.qmd` instead of
  `chapters/intro.qmd`.
- **A chapter was renamed or moved** without updating `_quarto.yml`.
- **A new chapter was added to the list** but the file was never
  created.

## How to fix

Create the missing file, or correct the entry in `_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
book:
  title: "My Book"
  chapters:
    - index.qmd
    - intro.qmd     # must exist in the project directory
    - summary.qmd
```

If you meant to drop the chapter, remove its entry from the list.
